agent.problem: This fill-in-the-blank asks for wording from verse 9 that the baker has not seen and cannot reason out. The earlier cards establish the people's deceit and rebellion, but give no basis for choosing that the LORD will delay His wrath rather than double or release it.

rule.text: The rule against guessing the next words of a line (see below) applies to every passage, and to fill in the blank too. The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.
